guia.what: A label for classifying or filtering content—categories, applied filters, keywords. Unlike the Badge, it’s designed to be interactive: clickable (`is-clickable`) and/or dismissible (`data-ts-dismissible`), with a prefix, sizes, and shapes.
whenUse: Representing applied filters the user can remove one by one.
Listing keywords or categories people can click to navigate or filter.
The user adds and removes items from a set.
whenAvoid: It’s purely informational and nobody will click it → `badge`.
It’s a choice between a few mutually exclusive options → `segmented-control`.
dos: If it’s dismissible, removing it should have an immediate, visible effect.
Keep labels short. Tags are read as a group, not one by one.
donts: Don’t make a tag clickable if it leads nowhere. It promises something it doesn’t deliver.
Don’t mix interactive tags with informational labels in the same row → use `badge` for those.

teclado.action: Activates the remove button, when the tag is removable.

nucleo: It’s dismissible and responds to the keyboard. Removes the tag on click or Backspace and notifies the container. An `is-clickable` tag also responds to Enter and Space, with the same `click` as a button.
